notes.title: 20240828_update_cross-section view added!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1PBCBoO.jpg[/img]

功能新增!
在主角房間中跟綠色水晶互動，可開啟或關閉斷面圖功能。

Now you can switch on "cross-section view" by interacting with the green crystal in your room.

notes.title: 20240823 更新註記(update)
notes.content:
色圖精液量提升。
感謝玩家們的耐心等候，回饋與寶貴意見。

The amount of semen in the explicit images has been increased.
Thank you for valuable feedback and suggestions.

notes.title: 20240822 pictures update!
notes.content:
圖片已經進行修正。
感謝玩家們的回饋與建議。

We appreciate the feedback and suggestions from the players.
All images with flaws have been optimized.

notes.title: 20240815: add difficulty selection
notes.content:
增加難易度選擇
We add difficulty selection.
Now you can go to your house to find an orb for this setting.

notes.title: 8月15更新註記
notes.content:
親愛的玩家們好，

我們已經將部分被馬賽克的圖片替換成無馬賽克的圖片。

很抱歉因為我們的錯誤導致了您的不便。

其餘圖片的調整作業仍在進行中，我們會盡快完成。

遊戲體驗部份的問題，也是來自於我們的缺乏經驗所致。

這部份我們也正在進行調整中，我們對所有玩家感到萬分抱歉。

Dear Players,

We have replaced some of the censored images with uncensored ones.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by our mistake.

The adjustments for the remaining images are still in progress, and we will complete them as soon as possible.

The issues affecting the game experience are also due to our lack of experience.

We are currently working on addressing these issues as well, and we deeply apologize to all players.

notes.title: 《Happy Town》has been released on Steam！
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thank you for your patience. Happy Town is now officially released!

We hope this game brings you wonderful memories. Your enjoyment is our honor.

If you encounter any issues while playing, feel free to leave a message on Discord. 
We will do our best to provide you with the best experience.

If you enjoy this game, please feel free to leave a review on Steam.

Your review warms our hearts and makes our day.

Thank you for your support. We hope you enjoy our game!
